content.text: {"id": "mm5841a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from the National Respiratory and Enteric Viruses Surveillance System (NREVSS)."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the number of positive test results was 64% lower than the prevaccine period"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the number of positive test results reported during the 2007--08 and 2008--09 seasons was lower than the median"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The peak percentage of positive rotavirus test results was 17% during the 2007--08 season"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Durations of the 2007--08 and 2008--09 rotavirus seasons were 14 weeks and 17 weeks, respectively"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The peak percentage of positive rotavirus test results was 17% during the 2007--08 season"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "compared with a median of 43% (range: 37--56%) during 2000--2006."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "NREVSS is a national, passive laboratory surveillance network that monitors temporal and geographic trends"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "To characterize trends and compare the 2007--08 and 2008--09 rotavirus seasons with the prevaccine period 2000--2006"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The onset of rotavirus season was defined as the first of 2 consecutive weeks"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "these periods were examined to compare dates of rotavirus season onset and offset and peak incidence"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data from the transitional season (July 2006--June 2007) were excluded"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "from 29 NREVSS laboratories that consistently reported ≥30 weeks of data per season during 2000--2009"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
